title: Android Auto™ | Hyundai
author: HyundaiUSA
shortDescription:
Model shown in video is for demonstration purposes only. Availability and functionality on your vehicle may vary.

Hyundai offers two different methods to use Android Auto™ connectivity, depending on your model and touchscreen. Watch this video to learn how to connect with both wired and wireless connections.
